profile.name: Daniel Reyes
profile.summary: Backend engineer with 7 years of experience building high-traffic APIs. Enjoy mentoring and pragmatic architecture.

descriptions: Designed and shipped 12 microservices in Node.js and TypeScript handling 3M requests/day
Built RESTful APIs on top of Postgres; reduced p95 latency by 40% through query tuning
Containerized services with Docker and deployed to AWS (ECS, Lambda)
Maintained GitHub Actions pipelines for continuous integration and delivery
Led pull request reviews for a team of 6 and ran Scrum ceremonies
Wrote Jest unit tests, raising coverage from 45% to 85%
Introduced Redis caching for session data
Helped migrate legacy PHP endpoints to Node
TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Terraform, Git
